entities.summary: Kurt Ehrenreich Floericke was a German naturalist and author of numerous popular science books. He also edited the Kosmos magazine in Stuttgart from 1907. An early advocate of bird protection, he sought the establishment of a bird sanctuary on Lake Constance.
